svg.aria-label: Left, a globular cluster of synthetic stars far along the telescope's axis, the column of sky the one-degree field covers, and the detector facing it with the cluster landed on its pixels; seven stars near one line of sight through the core are ringed and their light paths meet on the target's raised mask. Right, the mask in detail: seven by seven pixels with the mask shaded, the half-maximum circle of the target and of each neighbour, and a bar splitting the light the mask collects into the target's and the neighbours', a stellar pollution ratio of 0.74 for this drawing.
